newsitem.title: USA: Hanger Orthopedic secures merger financing.
newsitem.headline: Hanger Orthopedic secures merger financing.

text.p: Hanger Orthopedic Group Inc said Thursday it had received a senior financing commitment of $88 million from Banque Paribas SA in connection with its previously announced merger with J.E. Hanger Inc of Georgia.
Closing is expected on or about October 31, the company said.

The financing will be used with about $8 million raised from the issuance of subordinated notes and $5 million cash to fund a $44 million cash consideration to J.E. Hanger shareholders, the company said.
It will also be used to refinance about $20 million of Hanger and J.E. Hanger senior debt and make a $25 million line of credit for future acquisitions and merger expenses, the company said.
